title: Understanding One-Hot Encoding
text: When you one-hot encode a categorical variable, each category becomes a separate binary column. For example, if you have a column with three categories, you will create three new columns, each representing one of the categories.

title: Intercept Term in Regression
text: An intercept term in a regression model is a constant that allows the model to fit the data better by shifting the regression line up or down. It is often represented as a column of ones in the design matrix.

hintAnswer: Linear dependence due to one hot encoded columns with an intercept term
title: Identifying Linear Dependence
text: Consider how one-hot encoding and the intercept term might create linear dependence. If you have a one-hot encoded column for each category, what happens when you add an intercept term?
choices: Linear dependence due to one hot encoded columns with an intercept term
More features than data points (20 data points, $$21$$ features)
The nonlinear transformations create duplicate columns
The intercept term is always zero
The design matrix has more rows than columns
